details.description: Meta Llama 3 70B Instruct is Meta's original 70-billion-parameter instruction-tuned chat model, released April 18, 2024, optimized for English-language dialogue and code generation. It was trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback. Meta's lineup has since moved on to Llama 3.1, 3.3, and Llama 4, though Meta's own model card for this model does not itself mark it deprecated.
advantages: Meta reports 82.0% on MMLU (5-shot), 93.0% on GSM-8K (8-shot), and 81.7% pass@1 on HumanEval (0-shot) for the instruction-tuned model.
Meta reports 50.4 on MATH for the instruction-tuned model.
disadvantages: Meta's model card specifies a native 8,192-token context window, narrower than Meta's later Llama 3.1, 3.2, and 3.3 releases.
Meta designed and evaluated this model for English only; other languages require developer fine-tuning.
Superseded within Meta's own lineup by Llama 3.1, 3.3, and Llama 4, though Meta's model card does not explicitly label it deprecated.
Meta states the model may produce inaccurate, biased, or other objectionable responses and recommends tools like Llama Guard for deployment.
use_cases: Commercial and research natural language generation

notes: GROUPING/CONFLICT: catalog facts give this model 131072 max input/output tokens, but Meta's official model card (both the Hugging Face page and the llama-models GitHub MODEL_CARD.md) states a native 8,192-token context window for Llama 3 70B Instruct -- the original architecture predates the long-context work in Llama 3.1+. Kept the catalog's value per instructions and left the specific figure out of the description, but this is a large enough discrepancy (16x) that it may indicate a data error or that Hyperbolic is serving an extended-context variant not documented on Meta's own pages.
